paragraphs.text: Yuriko , the Tiger's Shadow , is a human ninja from Kamigawa .

On the plane of Kamigawa , the identity of the Tiger's Shadow is a mystery, but the monstrous face of the mask she wears inspires hope among the weak and terror in the mighty. She wields secrets as a weapon to debase the powerful and brings aid to the oppressed and afflicted.

Yuriko grew up hearing these stories, like all children on Kamigawa. As an orphan on the streets of Towashi , it brought her hope to imagine someone was watching over her. But when a brash Imperial guard lashed out at Yuriko's girlfriend, she realized the true nature of the hero. She strangled the man in the dark, and her girlfriend forged the legendary tiger claws soon after.
Guided by the principle that even those in the shadows should have allies, Yuriko stalks all of Towashi, protecting whatever the Emperor 's light cannot reach.

In the Echoverse , Yuriko instead grew up the child of a poet, hearing sagas of the ancient heroes of Kamigawa throughout her childhood. As a teenager, she decided to forge herself in their image, going through grueling training to become a samurai . She sought out Towashi's worst troublemakers and challenged them, quickly becoming a hero to the Kamigawan people, a symbol that anyone could take up the sword. When Tamiyo usurped the throne, Yuriko knew her time had come. Kamigawa had finally found a worthwhile ruler. Yuriko was the first to pledge her loyalty and remained at Tamiyo's side throughout her rule.
